reason: Mixed risk-reward: AMZN's operating momentum is strong (Q2 revenue +19.6%, operating income +43%, positive AWS/AI-demand headlines) and price remains above rising 50-/200-day SMAs, but it is below the 10-EMA, VWMA and the 262 gap floor with a negative MACD histogram and repeated rejection near 267. Negative free cash flow, heavy capex/debt funding and mark-driven earnings reduce the margin of safety; there is no confirmed breakout or attractive pullback entry yet.
risks: Failure to reclaim 262-267 supply could lead to a test of the 50-SMA near 252 and then a deeper gap-fill toward 240.
TTM free cash flow is negative after very large capex and acquisitions; continued debt issuance or slower AI/cloud demand could pressure the stock.
A large share of recent earnings comes from upward revaluations of non-marketable equity securities ($62.8B in H1); a markdown would hit reported earnings and book value.
News coverage is incomplete, insider data is unavailable, and the price-snapshot hash did not reproduce, raising data-quality uncertainty.
Valuation on core earnings remains high; Q3 capex, margin and tax/deferred-revenue details are key unresolved catalysts.
